component.name: Nexon Flatpak Store
component.summary: Browse, install, update and remove Flathub applications

description.p: Nexon Flatpak Store is a small, native application store for Flatpak. It talks directly to Flathub and to the Flatpak command line, so it works the same on every Linux distribution instead of depending on one vendor's software centre.

ul.li: Search the whole Flathub catalogue, or browse curated collections and categories.
Install applications, open them, and remove them again with one click.
See which of your applications have updates and update one or all of them.
Read the full description, screenshots, licence and latest release notes before installing.
Works inside the Flatpak sandbox by driving the host's flatpak through flatpak-spawn.
